Then during our Live

15
00:00:42,290 --> 00:00:43,790
WeChat red envelope cover

16
00:00:43,790 --> 00:00:49,070
Then I will explain in the first half

17
00:00:49,070 --> 00:00:50,790
how to make these two ponies

18
00:00:50,790 --> 00:00:53,240
Teacher Sherry will cover it in the final part

19

explain how to create our WeChat red packet cover

20
00:00:56,740 --> 00:00:58,660
the final carousel

21
00:00:58,660 --> 00:01:01,910
a very nice rendering

22
00:01:01,910 --> 00:01:04,930
Alright, let's get started.

23
00:01:16,860 --> 00:01:20,380
First up is our balloon pony

24
00:01:20,700 --> 00:01:24,340
Our balloon pony is composed of multiple balloon segments.

25
00:01:24,340 --> 00:01:27,940
So first, let's create a rectangular panel

26
00:01:27,940 --> 00:01:30,720
Then use the clone layer to duplicate it

27
00:01:30,720 --> 00:01:33,500
then flip its surface

28
00:01:37,160 --> 00:01:41,240
Then reduce its particle spacing and collision thickness

29
00:01:43,560 --> 00:01:45,680
then add a bit more pressure to it

30
00:01:45,680 --> 00:01:47,160
Now enable the simulation

31
00:01:47,160 --> 00:01:50,479
it will turn into a plump little pillow shape

32
00:01:50,479 --> 00:01:54,759
Then we'll delete the sewing lines on both short sides.

33
00:01:54,759 --> 00:01:58,450
change the sewing method of the long edge to

34
00:01:58,450 --> 00:01:59,970
change it to overlap seam

35
00:01:59,970 --> 00:02:02,410
it will form a tubular shape

36
00:02:03,490 --> 00:02:06,840
Then add elasticity to the two short edges

37
00:02:06,840 --> 00:02:09,240
set it to a ratio of 25

38
00:02:09,240 --> 00:02:10,680
it will shrink up

39
00:02:10,680 --> 00:02:13,470
like the shape of a sausage

40
00:02:13,630 --> 00:02:17,430
Then we reduce its warp and weft strength as well as diagonal tension

41
00:02:17,430 --> 00:02:19,310
to make it more elastic

42
00:02:19,310 --> 00:02:22,019
and increase its bending strength

43
00:02:22,019 --> 00:02:22,759
Uh, no

44
00:02:22,759 --> 00:02:24,339
reduce its bending stiffness

45
00:02:24,339 --> 00:02:27,899
so that it can produce more fine wrinkles

46
00:02:29,000 --> 00:02:33,800
This will make it look more like the shape of balloon skin

47
00:02:34,280 --> 00:02:35,480
After modifying the properties

48
00:02:35,480 --> 00:02:36,280
Let's simulate it

49
00:02:36,280 --> 00:02:37,140
take a look

50
00:02:37,140 --> 00:02:39,080
The elasticity still feels insufficient

51
00:02:39,080 --> 00:02:41,110
so I lowered it a bit more

52
00:02:41,110 --> 00:02:44,270
Mmm, adjust the warp and weft strength

53
00:02:46,400 --> 00:02:49,820
Then I adjusted its weight to make it a bit lighter.

54
00:02:49,820 --> 00:02:51,760
Because balloons are very light

55
00:02:51,760 --> 00:02:53,360
It ends up looking like this

56
00:02:53,360 --> 00:02:55,890
somewhat like the shape of a gummy candy

57
00:02:55,890 --> 00:03:00,850
Then we can start using this basic balloon segment

58
00:03:00,850 --> 00:03:04,930
to replicate the various structures of the pony's body

59
00:03:11,200 --> 00:03:14,000
First, duplicate two pairs of the pony's legs

60
00:03:15,200 --> 00:03:17,560
then comes the pony's body

61
00:03:19,520 --> 00:03:23,960
Next is the tail of the pony and the part of its neck

62
00:03:30,420 --> 00:03:31,140
Hello there

63
00:03:31,140 --> 00:03:32,620
QQ Field

64
00:03:34,020 --> 00:03:38,540
Then there's his head and two ears

65
00:03:40,940 --> 00:03:45,980
Then arrange the special mane on its back as well

66
00:03:46,870 --> 00:03:49,490
We copied three small balloon segments

67
00:03:49,490 --> 00:03:51,390
as its mane

68
00:03:54,640 --> 00:03:59,460
Then adjust the lengths of these balloon segments slightly

69
00:03:59,460 --> 00:04:03,000
to resemble the various parts of the pony

70
00:04:05,400 --> 00:04:07,320
quick adjustment

71
00:04:09,080 --> 00:04:10,480
After roughly placing them

72
00:04:10,480 --> 00:04:12,180
we can now start sewing

73
00:04:12,180 --> 00:04:14,060
Because its legs, uh,

74
00:04:14,060 --> 00:04:15,380
in real life

75
00:04:15,380 --> 00:04:17,540
It is a very long balloon

76
00:04:17,540 --> 00:04:20,089
to continuously twist and tie

77
00:04:20,089 --> 00:04:23,190
to create these body structures

78
00:04:23,190 --> 00:04:28,320
So the upper and lower parts of our legs are all sewing groups

79
00:04:31,680 --> 00:04:36,280
sew each balloon segment to its designated position

80
00:04:49,660 --> 00:04:53,880
Sew the pony's head, body, and ears together

81
00:04:53,880 --> 00:04:55,340
Sometimes when sewing too fast

82
00:04:55,340 --> 00:04:57,810
Sewing line errors may occur

83
00:04:57,810 --> 00:05:00,990
just right-click the sewing button if it's reversed

84
00:05:00,990 --> 00:05:04,390
then just swap it over

85
00:05:08,360 --> 00:05:11,120
After checking that all these sewing lines are properly stitched

86
00:05:11,120 --> 00:05:12,600
we can then start the simulation

87
00:05:12,600 --> 00:05:15,409
Combine Xiao Man's body parts together

88
00:05:15,649 --> 00:05:19,769
Then we'll separately assemble these three brown mane balloon segments

89
00:05:19,769 --> 00:05:21,849
combine them together

90
00:05:23,520 --> 00:05:27,600
Then we stand up our little horse lying on the ground

91
00:05:30,020 --> 00:05:33,900
rotate its legs to the correct orientation

92
00:05:36,080 --> 00:05:41,490
and also rotate its ears to the side

93
00:05:41,490 --> 00:05:45,310
Then we can begin to locally freeze some panels

94
00:05:45,310 --> 00:05:50,220
to perform more delicate simulation of this pony's body

95
00:05:50,220 --> 00:05:51,280
and adjustments

96
00:05:51,280 --> 00:05:54,580
Since I feel the legs of this little horse are a bit short here

97
00:05:54,580 --> 00:05:58,550
so I froze the other parts of its body

98
00:05:58,550 --> 00:06:01,410
then lengthened the legs of this little horse

99
00:06:01,410 --> 00:06:04,840
Then simulate it again, hmm

100
00:06:04,840 --> 00:06:10,739
Hmm, then added a bunch of, uh, inner lines on the pony's face

101
00:06:10,739 --> 00:06:13,019
Added an additional inner line

102
00:06:13,019 --> 00:06:14,919
then gave it elasticity

103
00:06:14,919 --> 00:06:16,459
It's like a rubber band

104
00:06:16,459 --> 00:06:18,579
like a band tightening around the pony's nose

105
00:06:18,579 --> 00:06:22,230
giving it the feeling of a pony's face

106
00:06:22,350 --> 00:06:25,850
Then sew its ears on as well

107
00:06:25,850 --> 00:06:28,050
This part was forgotten to be sewn earlier

108
00:06:28,050 --> 00:06:30,430
Its ears should be the same as its legs

109
00:06:30,430 --> 00:06:31,750
both the top and bottom are sewn together

110
00:06:31,750 --> 00:06:34,150
this this structure

111
00:06:35,680 --> 00:06:39,800
How could it be

112
00:06:49,160 --> 00:06:52,340
Then here, I added two connecting parts to its mane section

113
00:06:52,340 --> 00:06:55,160
added two connecting parts

114
00:06:55,160 --> 00:06:57,980
Because if we directly attach this mane part

115
00:06:57,980 --> 00:07:00,300
connected to the pony's body

116
00:07:00,300 --> 00:07:04,570
between the ear and the neck

117
00:07:04,570 --> 00:07:08,090
and the gap between the body and the neck is too deep

118
00:07:08,090 --> 00:07:12,159
will cause deformation in the mane area

119
00:07:12,159 --> 00:07:16,139
so we need two small connecting pieces without pressure

120
00:07:16,139 --> 00:07:20,919
to replace our mane part and insert them into these gaps

121
00:07:46,160 --> 00:07:49,840
We'll sew these two connectors together

122
00:07:49,840 --> 00:07:53,040
Sew it to both sides of the mane

123
00:07:59,260 --> 00:07:59,860
Yes

124
00:07:59,860 --> 00:08:01,100
this balloon pony

125
00:08:01,100 --> 00:08:03,540
It's actually the more common version we usually see

126
00:08:03,540 --> 00:08:05,900
a variation of the balloon dog

127
00:08:06,830 --> 00:08:09,630


128
00:08:09,630 --> 00:08:14,539
then add a mane to the back of the little dog

129
00:08:14,539 --> 00:08:15,699
and its neck

130
00:08:15,699 --> 00:08:19,560
seems to be a bit longer than the usual balloon dog

131
00:08:19,720 --> 00:08:21,900
Then we attach these two connectors

132
00:08:21,900 --> 00:08:24,720
sew it into the neck gap

133
00:08:26,580 --> 00:08:31,860
Then adjusted the size of the mane on its back

134
00:08:41,159 --> 00:08:44,120
Because the middle part of the mane

135
00:08:44,120 --> 00:08:46,600
still doesn't quite fit the pony's body

136
00:08:46,600 --> 00:08:49,480
so I've hidden a fixing pin here

137
00:08:57,580 --> 00:09:01,200
Then I'm going to take the eye section of the pony

138
00:09:01,200 --> 00:09:03,640
become the curved base of the balloon

139
00:09:03,640 --> 00:09:08,000
So I disabled the elasticity of this part

140
00:09:08,000 --> 00:09:09,940
Then I'll sew them together

141
00:09:09,940 --> 00:09:13,320
Then use the Generate Smooth Curve function

142
00:09:13,320 --> 00:09:16,900
round off its nose part

143
00:09:17,450 --> 00:09:20,450
Then I felt that using only the smooth curve generation

144
00:09:20,450 --> 00:09:22,450
Its nose still seems a bit too square

145
00:09:22,450 --> 00:09:25,650
so I adjusted the curve points individually again

146
00:09:32,200 --> 00:09:35,080
Now that we've completed the facial part of our little horse

147
00:09:35,080 --> 00:09:40,080
Now we start making the knotted part of the balloon tail.

148
00:09:41,200 --> 00:09:45,200
First, create a rectangular panel

149
00:09:49,940 --> 00:09:53,380
Then we start making our knot

150
00:09:54,090 --> 00:09:59,410
Add a full row of fixed pins to both sides of our panel

151
00:10:00,090 --> 00:10:04,730
Then also add some adjustable fixed pins in the middle for convenience.

152
00:10:04,730 --> 00:10:07,450
Then we begin our knot tying.

153
00:10:08,120 --> 00:10:12,240
The advantage of adding a full row of fixed pins on both sides like this is

154
00:10:12,240 --> 00:10:16,599
we can rotate both sides of the panel

155
00:10:16,759 --> 00:10:20,279
This makes it more convenient for us when tying knots

156
00:10:20,279 --> 00:10:22,829
pass through some small gaps

157
00:10:22,829 --> 00:10:25,689
Then I assigned a new fabric to this knot panel

158
00:10:25,689 --> 00:10:27,389
a new fabric

159
00:10:27,389 --> 00:10:29,599
then increase its friction coefficient

160
00:10:29,599 --> 00:10:31,959
so when we tighten this knot

161
00:10:31,959 --> 00:10:33,839
its speed will become slower

162
00:10:33,839 --> 00:10:36,759
it won't come loose as easily

163
00:10:43,500 --> 00:10:45,060
After making this knot

164
00:10:45,060 --> 00:10:50,500
we can trim the excessively long parts on both sides

165
00:10:57,000 --> 00:11:02,840
Then sew this knot onto the little horse's tail

166
00:11:04,600 --> 00:11:07,840
Then we use the fixing pins to secure the knot part

167
00:11:07,840 --> 00:11:09,920
then adjust its collision thickness

168
00:11:11,160 --> 00:11:12,579
Reduce the collision thickness to one

169
00:11:12,579 --> 00:11:16,279
Here, I noticed that when I previously created this panel

170
00:11:16,279 --> 00:11:17,919
I adjusted its particle spacing

171
00:11:17,919 --> 00:11:19,920
but did not change its collision thickness

172
00:11:19,920 --> 00:11:21,880
I was at its collision thickness

173
00:11:21,880 --> 00:11:25,900
Keep it at 2.5 when making this knot

174
00:11:25,900 --> 00:11:29,150
Then I'm going to duplicate this layer

175
00:11:29,150 --> 00:11:31,490
turn it into a tubular shape

176
00:11:31,490 --> 00:11:33,310
a double-layered knot structure

177
00:11:33,310 --> 00:11:34,750


178
00:11:34,750 --> 00:11:37,950
I then set its collision thickness to 1

179
00:11:37,950 --> 00:11:41,380
In this way, without simulation

180
00:11:41,380 --> 00:11:45,860
the gap between the fabrics in this knot

181
00:11:45,860 --> 00:11:49,400
will, due to my reduction of the collision thickness

182
00:11:49,400 --> 00:11:51,180
an additional 1.5mm thickness

183
00:11:51,180 --> 00:11:56,590
So I use the cloning layer function to clone out

184
00:11:56,590 --> 00:11:58,050
the inner layer

185
00:11:58,050 --> 00:12:00,250
so it has gaps

186
00:12:00,250 --> 00:12:03,979
can be re-simulated inside here

187
00:12:03,979 --> 00:12:06,260
it is less prone to collision

188
00:12:06,260 --> 00:12:07,780
not so prone to penetration

189
00:12:07,780 --> 00:12:09,520
and then various instabilities occur

190
00:12:09,520 --> 00:12:13,180
and also prevents the knot from coming loose

191
00:12:19,020 --> 00:12:20,580
Increase friction

192
00:12:20,580 --> 00:12:24,220
Increasing friction can help the fabric

193
00:12:24,220 --> 00:12:28,170
when you tighten the knot, it will slow down a bit

194
00:12:28,170 --> 00:12:32,570
then it will reduce the possibility of direct penetration

195
00:12:38,920 --> 00:12:41,080
Then we sew the copied inner layer

196
00:12:41,080 --> 00:12:45,320
also sew the inner layer onto the little pony's butt

197
00:12:53,260 --> 00:12:56,140
Then continue to adjust it to look more natural

198
00:12:56,140 --> 00:12:58,260
Because the knot feels a bit too big

199
00:12:58,260 --> 00:13:00,500
so I applied a weft shrinkage rate to it

200
00:13:00,500 --> 00:13:02,480
make this knot a bit smaller

201
00:13:02,650 --> 00:13:06,290
Then continue to freeze the knot part

202
00:13:06,290 --> 00:13:11,130
Then simulate this part of our pony's tail

203
00:13:11,550 --> 00:13:14,990
Adjust the elasticity ratio of these two short edges

204
00:13:14,990 --> 00:13:17,390
make it a bit smaller

205
00:13:19,400 --> 00:13:22,200
This will make it look more like it's tightly tied

206
00:13:22,200 --> 00:13:24,160
more natural

207
00:13:35,680 --> 00:13:39,340
Then we unfreeze all the panels for a brief simulation

208
00:13:39,340 --> 00:13:42,280
to simulate the relationship between the fabrics more accurately

209
00:13:42,280 --> 00:13:44,480
simulate more accurately

210
00:13:44,769 --> 00:13:46,249
After confirming the shape

211
00:13:46,249 --> 00:13:51,369
we can start creating the inflation for this little pony

212
00:13:52,009 --> 00:13:56,489
Here I've selected an MD icon color for the little pony

213
00:13:56,489 --> 00:13:59,409
Wishing everyone success in the Year of the Horse.

214
00:13:59,650 --> 00:14:02,850
Then change its material to plastic

215
00:14:05,320 --> 00:14:08,560
then increased its surface strength

216
00:14:09,960 --> 00:14:12,560
reduced its roughness

217
00:14:14,120 --> 00:14:18,080
Then I loaded a coin-shaped texture

218
00:14:18,080 --> 00:14:20,600
as the pony's eyes

219
00:14:24,680 --> 00:14:28,320
Then when we use this type of texture

220
00:14:28,320 --> 00:14:30,400
enable at the seams

221
00:14:30,400 --> 00:14:34,180
This pattern can span across two panels for use.

222
00:14:43,220 --> 00:14:47,900
Then in order to make the sewing lines on the pony's surface

223
00:14:47,900 --> 00:14:49,420
not so noticeable

224
00:14:49,420 --> 00:14:54,470
So I merged all these sewing lines

225
00:14:55,280 --> 00:15:00,160
This way it will look more like a seamless balloon.

226
00:15:12,480 --> 00:15:16,680
Merge all the sewing lines on the side facing us

227
00:15:27,180 --> 00:15:28,880
As for the back part,

228
00:15:28,880 --> 00:15:31,340
Because we only have one panel now

229
00:15:31,340 --> 00:15:32,700
already gone around once

230
00:15:32,700 --> 00:15:35,440
but we can still make

231
00:15:35,760 --> 00:15:38,680
It can still be made less noticeable

232
00:15:38,680 --> 00:15:43,090
I just deleted the one on the normal line, oh

00:15:43,090 --> 00:15:45,490
not the normal map on the sewing line

234
00:15:45,490 --> 00:15:47,760
It will become even less noticeable.

00:15:47,760 --> 00:15:51,040
Then within the same pattern piece,

Currently in our software, if it's on the same pattern piece

Even if the texture is applied and the seams are enabled

00:10:31,959 --> 00:10:33,839
ستصبح حركتها أبطأ قليلاً،

162
00:10:33,839 --> 00:10:36,759
ولن تتفكك بسهولة.

163
00:10:43,500 --> 00:10:45,060
بعد أن قمنا بعقد هذه العقدة

164
00:10:45,060 --> 00:10:50,500
يمكننا إزالة الأجزاء الطويلة جدًا على الجانبين

165
00:10:57,000 --> 00:11:02,840
ثم نخيط هذه العقدة على ذيل المهر الصغير

166
00:11:04,600 --> 00:11:07,840
ثم نثبت العقدة بالدبابيس.

167
00:11:07,840 --> 00:11:09,920
ثم نضبط سمك الاصطدام

168
00:11:11,160 --> 00:11:12,579
ونخفض سمك الاصطدام إلى واحد.

169
00:11:12,579 --> 00:11:16,279
هنا لاحظت أنني عندما أنشأت هذه اللوحة سابقًا،

170
00:11:16,279 --> 00:11:17,919
قمت بتغيير تباعد الجسيمات الخاص بها،

171
00:11:17,919 --> 00:11:19,920
لكنني لم أغير سُمك التصادم.

172
00:11:19,920 --> 00:11:21,880
لقد صممت هذه العقدة بينما كان سمك الاصطدام

173
00:11:21,880 --> 00:11:25,900
2.5، وهذا هو ما حافظت عليه.

174
00:11:25,900 --> 00:11:29,150
والآن، سأقوم بنسخ طبقة أخرى.

175
00:11:29,150 --> 00:11:31,490
لتحويلها إلى شكل أنبوبي.

176
00:11:31,490 --> 00:11:33,310
هيكل معقود مزدوج الطبقات.

177
00:11:33,310 --> 00:11:34,750
ثم قبل النسخ.

178
00:11:34,750 --> 00:11:37,950
لقد قمت بتغيير سُمك التصادم إلى واحد فقط.

179
00:11:37,950 --> 00:11:41,380
وبهذه الطريقة، ودون الحاجة إلى المحاكاة،

180
00:11:41,380 --> 00:11:45,860
يمكن رؤية الفجوة بين طبقات القماش في العقدة.

181
00:11:45,860 --> 00:11:49,400
وبسبب تقليل سماكة التصادم

182
00:11:49,400 --> 00:11:51,180
سأحصل على سماكة إضافية قدرها 1.5

183
00:11:51,180 --> 00:11:56,590
وبهذه الطريقة، سأستخدم وظيفة الطبقات المستنسخة لإنشاء نسخة مطابقة.

184
00:11:56,590 --> 00:11:58,050
عندما يكون هناك طبقة داخلية

185
00:11:58,050 --> 00:12:00,250
سيكون هناك فجوة

186
00:12:00,250 --> 00:12:03,979
يمكننا إعادة المحاكاة بداخلها

187
00:12:03,979 --> 00:12:06,260
لا تصطدم بسهولة كبيرة.

188
00:12:06,260 --> 00:12:07,780
لا تخترق بسهولة.

189
00:12:07,780 --> 00:12:09,520
ثم لا تحدث العديد من المشكلات.

190
00:12:09,520 --> 00:12:13,180
وكذلك لن تُفك العقدة.

191
00:12:19,020 --> 00:12:20,580
زيادة الاحتكاك

192
00:12:20,580 --> 00:12:24,220
زيادة الاحتكاك يمكن أن تجعل القماش

193
00:12:24,220 --> 00:12:28,170
هذا يعني أنك عندما تشد العقدة، ستصبح أبطأ.

194
00:12:28,170 --> 00:12:32,570
وسيقلل ذلك من احتمالية اختراقها مباشرة.

195
00:12:38,920 --> 00:12:41,080
ثم نضع النسخة التي قمنا بنسخها بالداخل.

196
00:12:41,080 --> 00:12:45,320
وطبقة أخرى مخيطة على مؤخرة المهر الصغير.

197
00:12:53,260 --> 00:12:56,140
ثم نعدلها لتصبح طبيعية أكثر.

198
00:12:56,140 --> 00:12:58,260
لأنني أشعر أن هذه العقدة كبيرة جدًا.

199
00:12:58,260 --> 00:13:00,500
لذلك قمت بتقليل عرضه قليلاً.

200
00:13:00,500 --> 00:13:02,480
لجعل هذه العقدة أصغر قليلًا.

201
00:13:02,650 --> 00:13:06,290
ثم أواصل تجميد جزء العقدة الخاص بنا.

202
00:13:06,290 --> 00:13:11,130
ثم نقوم بمحاكاة جزء ذيل حصاننا هذا.

203
00:13:11,550 --> 00:13:14,990
ونجعل نسبة مرونة جانبيه القصيرين

204
00:13:14,990 --> 00:13:17,390
أصغر قليلاً.

205
00:13:19,400 --> 00:13:22,200
هكذا يبدو وكأنه مشدود أكثر

206
00:13:22,200 --> 00:13:24,160
أكثر طبيعية

207
00:13:35,680 --> 00:13:39,340
ثم نقوم بإلغاء تجميد جميع الألواح ونقوم بمحاكاة قصيرة

208
00:13:39,340 --> 00:13:42,280
لكي تكون العلاقة بين الأقمشة

209
00:13:42,280 --> 00:13:44,480
أكثر دقة في المحاكاة

210
00:13:44,769 --> 00:13:46,249
بعد التأكد من الشكل

211
00:13:46,249 --> 00:13:51,369
يمكننا الآن البدء في تصميم هذا المهر الصغير.

212
00:13:52,009 --> 00:13:56,489
لقد اخترت للمهر هنا لونًا من أيقونة MD.

213
00:13:56,489 --> 00:13:59,409
أتمنى لكم جميعًا سنة جديدة موفقة وناجحة.

214
00:13:59,650 --> 00:14:02,850
ثم قمت بتغيير مادته إلى البلاستيك.

215
00:14:05,320 --> 00:14:08,560
ثم زدت قوة سطحه.

216
00:14:09,960 --> 00:14:12,560
وقللت من خشونته.

217
00:14:14,120 --> 00:14:18,080
بعد ذلك، قمت بتحميل ملصق على شكل عملة نحاسية.

218
00:14:18,080 --> 00:14:20,600
لاستخدامه كعين للحصان الصغير.

219
00:14:24,680 --> 00:14:28,320
وعندما نستخدم هذا النوع من الملصقات،

220
00:14:28,320 --> 00:14:30,400
يمكننا تفعيل الخياطة عند هذه النقطة

221
00:14:30,400 --> 00:14:34,180
وهكذا يمكن استخدام هذا النمط على قطعتين

222
00:14:43,220 --> 00:14:47,900
وبعد ذلك، لجعل خطوط الخياطة على سطح المهر

223
00:14:47,900 --> 00:14:49,420
لا يؤثر كثيراً.

224
00:14:49,420 --> 00:14:54,470
لذلك قمت بدمج كل خطوط الخياطة هذه.

225
00:14:55,280 --> 00:15:00,160
وبهذه الطريقة سيبدو وكأنه بالون بلا خياطة.

226
00:15:12,480 --> 00:15:16,680
سأقوم بدمج جميع خطوط الخياطة التي تواجهنا.

227
00:15:27,180 --> 00:15:28,880
وماذا عن الجزء الخلفي؟

228
00:15:28,880 --> 00:15:31,340
لأن لدينا الآن لوحًا واحدًا فقط.

229
00:15:31,340 --> 00:15:32,700
لقد قمنا بالفعل بعمل لفة كاملة

230
00:15:32,700 --> 00:15:35,440
ولكن لا يزال بإمكاننا جعلها

231
00:15:35,760 --> 00:15:38,680
لا يزال بإمكاننا أن نجعلها أقل وضوحًا قليلاً.

232
00:15:38,680 --> 00:15:43,090
لقد قمت بحذف الملمس العادي (Normal Map) الموجود على

233
00:15:43,090 --> 00:15:45,490
ليس ملمس الخياطة العادي (Sewing Line Normal Map).

234
00:15:45,490 --> 00:15:47,760
وسيصبح أقل وضوحًا.

235
00:15:47,760 --> 00:15:51,040
ثم في نفس اللوح،

236
00:15:51,040 --> 00:15:54,430
حاليًا في برنامجنا، إذا كان على نفس اللوح،

237
00:15:54,430 --> 00:15:59,440
حتى لو قمت بتشغيل الملصق ووضعه عند التماس،

238
00:15:59,440 --> 00:16:02,320
لا يمكن استخدامه مباشرة عبر الأنماط المختلفة.

239
00:16:02,320 --> 00:16:04,260
لذا يمكنكم تكراره مرة أخرى

240
00:16:04,260 --> 00:16:06,250
ثم تجميعه بأنفسكم.

241
00:16:06,250 --> 00:16:10,450
ثم طبقت هنا شبكة رباعية الأضلاع.

242
00:16:10,450 --> 00:16:13,110
هذا يجعل سطح نموذجنا

243
00:16:13,110 --> 00:16:16,170
أكثر نعومة.

244
00:16:18,280 --> 00:16:19,360
حسنًا، هكذا،

245
00:16:19,360 --> 00:16:23,040
أصبح حصان البالون الخاص بنا جاهزًا!

1
00:00:00,280 --> 00:00:00,720
Olá.

2
00:00:00,720 --> 00:00:01,320
Olá a todos.

3
00:00:01,320 --> 00:00:05,830
Eu sou HAZ, um designer da Marvelous Designer.

4
00:00:05,830 --> 00:00:08,430
Hoje à noite, com as festas de Ano Novo chegando,

5
00:00:08,430 --> 00:00:12,059
vamos trazer para vocês duas coisinhas, uh,

6
00:00:12,059 --> 00:00:14,159
no Marvelous Designer.

7
00:00:14,159 --> 00:00:17,239
Tutorial de como fazer dois estilos de pôneis

8
00:00:17,239 --> 00:00:20,869
E ao lado está nossa velha amiga, a Professora Shirley,

9
00:00:20,869 --> 00:00:22,169
Professora Xuemei.

10
00:00:23,809 --> 00:00:27,060
A professora Xue Lin estará presente durante minha transmissão ao vivo,

11
00:00:27,060 --> 00:00:30,500
atuando como uma assistente para responder às suas perguntas nos comentários.

12
00:00:30,500 --> 00:00:33,140
E durante a nossa transmissão ao vivo,

13
00:00:33,140 --> 00:00:36,360
E no final, teremos sorteios também!

14
00:00:36,360 --> 00:00:42,290
Além disso, você pode obter gratuitamente o nosso

15
00:00:42,290 --> 00:00:43,790
Capa de envelope vermelho do WeChat.

16
00:00:43,790 --> 00:00:49,070
Então, na primeira parte, vou explicar

17
00:00:49,070 --> 00:00:50,790
como fazer esses dois cavalinhos.

18
00:00:50,790 --> 00:00:53,240
A professora Shirley vai fazer a parte final.

19
00:00:53,240 --> 00:00:56,740
Eu vou ensinar como fazer a capa do nosso envelope vermelho do WeChat.

20
00:00:56,740 --> 00:00:58,660
Aquelas renderizações tão bonitas do carrossel no final, ok?

21
00:00:58,660 --> 00:01:01,910
Aquelas renderizações tão bonitas do carrossel no final, ok?

22
00:01:01,910 --> 00:01:04,930
Então, vamos começar.

23
00:01:16,860 --> 00:01:20,380
O primeiro é o nosso cavalinho de balão.

24
00:01:20,700 --> 00:01:24,340
Nosso cavalinho de balão é composto por muitos segmentos de balão.

25
00:01:24,340 --> 00:01:27,940
Então, primeiro, vamos criar uma placa retangular.

26
00:01:27,940 --> 00:01:30,720
Depois, vamos cloná-la com uma camada de clonagem.

27
00:01:30,720 --> 00:01:33,500
E, em seguida, vamos virar a superfície dela.

28
00:01:37,160 --> 00:01:41,240
Depois, vou reduzir o espaçamento das partículas e a espessura da colisão.

29
00:01:43,560 --> 00:01:45,680
Vou adicionar um pouco de pressão.

30
00:01:45,680 --> 00:01:47,160
E agora, inicio a simulação.

31
00:01:47,160 --> 00:01:50,479
vai se transformar em uma almofadinha fofa e cheia.

32
00:01:50,479 --> 00:01:54,759
Depois, vamos excluir as costuras dos dois lados curtos.

33
00:01:54,759 --> 00:01:58,450
E vamos mudar a forma de costura do lado comprido para, uh,

34
00:01:58,450 --> 00:01:59,970
Vamos mudar para costura sobreposta.

35
00:01:59,970 --> 00:02:02,410
Ele vai se transformar em um formato tubular.

36
00:02:03,490 --> 00:02:06,840
E então vamos adicionar elasticidade às duas bordas curtas.

37
00:02:06,840 --> 00:02:09,240
Vamos dar uma proporção de 25.

38
00:02:09,240 --> 00:02:10,680
Ele vai encolher,

39
00:02:10,680 --> 00:02:13,470
ficando com um formato de salsicha.

40
00:02:13,630 --> 00:02:17,430
Depois, reduzimos a resistência da trama e a tensão diagonal.

41
00:02:17,430 --> 00:02:19,310
Para que fique mais elástico.

42
00:02:19,310 --> 00:02:22,019
E aumentamos a resistência à flexão.

43
00:02:22,019 --> 00:02:22,759
Ah, não, espere.

44
00:02:22,759 --> 00:02:24,339
Vou diminuir sua rigidez de flexão

45
00:02:24,339 --> 00:02:27,899
Para que possa criar mais rugas pequenas.

46
00:02:29,000 --> 00:02:33,800
Assim, ele vai parecer mais com o formato da bexiga.

47
00:02:34,280 --> 00:02:35,480
Depois de alterar as propriedades,

48
00:02:35,480 --> 00:02:36,280
vamos simular.

49
00:02:36,280 --> 00:02:37,140
Dá uma olhada.

50
00:02:37,140 --> 00:02:39,080
Acho que a elasticidade ainda não é suficiente.

51
00:02:39,080 --> 00:02:41,110
Então, eu baixei um pouco mais.

52
00:02:41,110 --> 00:02:44,270
Uhm, a intensidade do fio de urdidura e trama.

53
00:02:46,400 --> 00:02:49,820
E então vou deixar o peso dele um pouco mais leve.

54
00:02:49,820 --> 00:02:51,760
Porque balões são muito leves, né?

55
00:02:51,760 --> 00:02:53,360
Ele ficou assim.

56
00:02:53,360 --> 00:02:55,890
Com uma forma que parece uma bala de goma.

57
00:02:55,890 --> 00:03:00,850
E então podemos começar a usar este segmento básico de balão.

58
00:03:00,850 --> 00:03:04,930
para copiar as várias estruturas do corpo do pônei.

59
00:03:11,200 --> 00:03:14,000
Primeiro, copie dois pares de pernas do pônei.

60
00:03:15,200 --> 00:03:17,560
Depois, o corpo do pônei.

61
00:03:19,520 --> 00:03:23,960
Em seguida, a cauda do pônei e a parte do pescoço.

62
00:03:30,420 --> 00:03:31,140
Olá!

63
00:03:31,140 --> 00:03:32,620
Cenário QQ

64
00:03:34,020 --> 00:03:38,540
Depois, vou montar a cabeça e as duas orelhas.

65
00:03:40,940 --> 00:03:45,980
Também vou colocar aquela juba especial nas costas dele.

66
00:03:46,870 --> 00:03:49,490
Vamos duplicar três pequenos segmentos de balão.

67
00:03:49,490 --> 00:03:51,390
como se fosse a crina.

68
00:03:54,640 --> 00:03:59,460
Depois, ajustamos um pouco o comprimento desses segmentos de balão,

69
00:03:59,460 --> 00:04:03,000
para que se pareçam mais com as partes do corpo do pônei.

70
00:04:05,400 --> 00:04:07,320
uma modificação rápida.

71
00:04:09,080 --> 00:04:10,480
Depois de os posicionar mais ou menos,

72
00:04:10,480 --> 00:04:12,180
podemos começar a costurar.

73
00:04:12,180 --> 00:04:14,060
Já que as pernas dele, uh,

74
00:04:14,060 --> 00:04:15,380
na vida real,

75
00:04:15,380 --> 00:04:17,540
são balões bem longos.

76
00:04:17,540 --> 00:04:20,089
para torcer e dar nós constantemente.

77
00:04:20,089 --> 00:04:23,190
e criamos estas estruturas corporais.

78
00:04:23,190 --> 00:04:28,320
Assim, a parte superior e inferior das nossas pernas são costuradas.

79
00:04:31,680 --> 00:04:36,280
Então, costuramos cada seção do balão no seu devido lugar.

80
00:04:49,660 --> 00:04:53,880
Costurei a cabeça, o corpo e as orelhas do cavalinho.

81
00:04:53,880 --> 00:04:55,340
Às vezes, quando costuramos rápido,

82
00:04:55,340 --> 00:04:57,810
pode acontecer de a costura sair errada.

83
00:04:57,810 --> 00:05:00,990
Basta inverter, clicar com o botão direito na costura.

84
00:05:00,990 --> 00:05:04,390
E depois é só ajustar.

85
00:05:08,360 --> 00:05:11,120
Depois de verificar se todas essas costuras estão bem feitas,

86
00:05:11,120 --> 00:05:12,600
podemos iniciar a simulação

87
00:05:12,600 --> 00:05:15,409
e unir o corpo do cavalinho.

88
00:05:15,649 --> 00:05:19,769
Então, vamos agrupar essas três seções de balões marrons de crina

89
00:05:19,769 --> 00:05:21,849
juntas.

90
00:05:23,520 --> 00:05:27,600
E agora, vamos levantar o nosso cavalinho que está deitado.

91
00:05:30,020 --> 00:05:33,900
Vamos girar as pernas para a direção certa.

92
00:05:36,080 --> 00:05:41,490
E as orelhas também, para os lados.

93
00:05:41,490 --> 00:05:45,310
Depois, podemos começar a congelar algumas partes seletivamente.

94
00:05:45,310 --> 00:05:50,220
para uma simulação mais detalhada do corpo do pônei.

95
00:05:50,220 --> 00:05:51,280
E também ajustar...

96
00:05:51,280 --> 00:05:54,580
Porque acho que as pernas do pônei estão um pouco curtas aqui.

97
00:05:54,580 --> 00:05:58,550
Então, eu congelei o resto do corpo dele,

98
00:05:58,550 --> 00:06:01,410
e depois alonguei as pernas do cavalinho.

99
00:06:01,410 --> 00:06:04,840
Aí sim, simulei de novo.

100
00:06:04,840 --> 00:06:10,739
Hum, então, adicionei uma série de, hum, na face do pônei.

101
00:06:10,739 --> 00:06:13,019
Adicionei uma linha interna.

102
00:06:13,019 --> 00:06:14,919
E então dei a ele um pouco de elasticidade.

103
00:06:14,919 --> 00:06:16,459
Ele é como um elástico.

104
00:06:16,459 --> 00:06:18,579
Como uma argola em volta do focinho do cavalinho.

105
00:06:18,579 --> 00:06:22,230
Dá-lhe a sensação do rosto de um cavalinho.

106
00:06:22,350 --> 00:06:25,850
E então ele costurou as orelhas também.

107
00:06:25,850 --> 00:06:28,050
Eu esqueci de costurar isso antes.

108
00:06:28,050 --> 00:06:30,430
As orelhas dele deveriam ser como as pernas.

109
00:06:30,430 --> 00:06:31,750
A parte superior e inferior estão costuradas.

110
00:06:31,750 --> 00:06:34,150
Esse tipo de estrutura...

111
00:06:35,680 --> 00:06:39,800
Ah, como assim?

112
00:06:49,160 --> 00:06:52,340
Aqui, eu adicionei duas conexões para a crina.

113
00:06:52,340 --> 00:06:55,160
Para a crina.

114
00:06:55,160 --> 00:06:57,980
Porque se nós conectarmos a crina diretamente,

115
00:06:57,980 --> 00:07:00,300
conectarmos ao corpo do pônei,

116
00:07:00,300 --> 00:07:04,570
a área entre as orelhas e o pescoço

117
00:07:04,570 --> 00:07:08,090
e a lacuna entre o corpo e o pescoço são muito profundas.

118
00:07:08,090 --> 00:07:12,159
Isso deformaria a crina nesta área.

119
00:07:12,159 --> 00:07:16,139
Portanto, precisamos de duas peças de conexão finas e sem pressão

120
00:07:16,139 --> 00:07:20,919
Para substituir a parte da crina e preencher essas lacunas.

121
00:07:46,160 --> 00:07:49,840
Vamos costurar essas duas peças de conexão.

122
00:07:49,840 --> 00:07:53,040
Costure-as nas laterais da crina.

123
00:07:59,260 --> 00:07:59,860
Sim.

124
00:07:59,860 --> 00:08:01,100
Este pônei de balão

125
00:08:01,100 --> 00:08:03,540
na verdade, é uma variação mais comum

126
00:08:03,540 --> 00:08:05,900
do cachorro de balão.

127
00:08:06,830 --> 00:08:09,630
É diminuir as orelhas do cachorrinho,

128
00:08:09,630 --> 00:08:14,539
e depois adicionar uma crina nas costas do cachorrinho,

129
00:08:14,539 --> 00:08:15,699
e também no pescoço.

130
00:08:15,699 --> 00:08:19,560
Também parece um pouco mais longo do que o cão-balão normal.

131
00:08:19,720 --> 00:08:21,900
Então, pegamos essas duas peças de conexão

132
00:08:21,900 --> 00:08:24,720
e as costuramos na fenda do pescoço dele.

133
00:08:26,580 --> 00:08:31,860
Ajustei o tamanho da crina na parte de trás.

134
00:08:41,159 --> 00:08:44,120
Porque a parte do meio da crina

135
00:08:44,120 --> 00:08:46,600
ainda não estava muito bem ajustada ao corpo do cavalinho.

136
00:08:46,600 --> 00:08:49,480
Então eu escondi um alfinete de fixação aqui.

137
00:08:57,580 --> 00:09:01,200
E agora, a parte dos olhos do cavalo...

138
00:09:01,200 --> 00:09:03,640
Eu vou transformá-la na base curva do balão.

139
00:09:03,640 --> 00:09:08,000
Então, eu vou cancelar a elasticidade desta parte.

140
00:09:08,000 --> 00:09:09,940
E depois costurei-as juntas.

141
00:09:09,940 --> 00:09:13,320
E então usei a função "Gerar Curva Suave".

142
00:09:13,320 --> 00:09:16,900
Arredondamos a parte do nariz.

143
00:09:17,450 --> 00:09:20,450
Achei que, usando apenas as curvas suaves geradas,

144
00:09:20,450 --> 00:09:22,450
o nariz ainda parecia um pouco quadrado.

145
00:09:22,450 --> 00:09:25,650
Então, ajustei novamente com pontos de curva.

146
00:09:32,200 --> 00:09:35,080
E depois de fazer o rosto do nosso cavalinho...

147
00:09:35,080 --> 00:09:40,080
...vamos começar a fazer a parte do nó da cauda do nosso balão.

148
00:09:41,200 --> 00:09:45,200
Primeiro, crie um painel retangular.

149
00:09:49,940 --> 00:09:53,380
Depois, vamos fazer os nós.

150
00:09:54,090 --> 00:09:59,410
Coloque uma fileira de pinos de fixação em ambos os lados do painel.

151
00:10:00,090 --> 00:10:04,730
E depois, no meio, fazemos alguns pontos de fixação para facilitar os ajustes.

152
00:10:04,730 --> 00:10:07,450
Então, começamos a fazer os nós.

153
00:10:08,120 --> 00:10:12,240
A vantagem de ter esses pontos de fixação em ambos os lados é que...

154
00:10:12,240 --> 00:10:16,599
Podemos girar os dois lados desta peça.

155
00:10:16,759 --> 00:10:20,279
Assim, fica mais fácil para nós na hora de fazer o nó,

156
00:10:20,279 --> 00:10:22,829
passar por pequenas frestas.

157
00:10:22,829 --> 00:10:25,689
Então, eu dei a esta peça com nós

158
00:10:25,689 --> 00:10:27,389
um novo tecido

159
00:10:27,389 --> 00:10:29,599
e aumentei o coeficiente de atrito dela.

160
00:10:29,599 --> 00:10:31,959
Assim, quando apertarmos o nó,

161
00:10:31,959 --> 00:10:33,839
a velocidade diminui um pouco,

162
00:10:33,839 --> 00:10:36,759
e não se desfaz tão facilmente.

163
00:10:43,500 --> 00:10:45,060
Depois de dar o nó,

164
00:10:45,060 --> 00:10:50,500
podemos cortar as partes laterais que estão muito compridas.

165
00:10:57,000 --> 00:11:02,840
E então costuramos este nó na cauda do cavalinho.

166
00:11:04,600 --> 00:11:07,840
Depois, usamos um alfinete para prender o nó.

167
00:11:07,840 --> 00:11:09,920
E depois sua espessura de colisão...

168
00:11:11,160 --> 00:11:12,579
...reduzimos a espessura de colisão para um.

169
00:11:12,579 --> 00:11:16,279
Notei que quando criei este painel antes,

170
00:11:16,279 --> 00:11:17,919
mudei a distância das partículas,

171
00:11:17,919 --> 00:11:19,920
mas não mudei a espessura da colisão.

172
00:11:19,920 --> 00:11:21,880
Eu estava no processo de criar este nó

173
00:11:21,880 --> 00:11:25,900
com uma espessura de colisão de 2,5.

174
00:11:25,900 --> 00:11:29,150
Agora, vou duplicá-lo para criar outra camada.

175
00:11:29,150 --> 00:11:31,490
para que fique tubular.

176
00:11:31,490 --> 00:11:33,310
a estrutura de nó de camada dupla.

177
00:11:33,310 --> 00:11:34,750
E antes de duplicar,

178
00:11:34,750 --> 00:11:37,950
Então, eu alterei a espessura de colisão para um.

179
00:11:37,950 --> 00:11:41,380
Dessa forma, sem a simulação,

180
00:11:41,380 --> 00:11:45,860
o espaço entre os tecidos no nó

181
00:11:45,860 --> 00:11:49,400
vai criar devido à redução da espessura de colisão.

182
00:11:49,400 --> 00:11:51,180
um aumento de espessura de 1.5.

183
00:11:51,180 --> 00:11:56,590
Então, eu uso a função de camada de clonagem para clonar.

184
00:11:56,590 --> 00:11:58,050
quando eu for trabalhar na camada de dentro,

185
00:11:58,050 --> 00:12:00,250
já que ela tem uma abertura,

186
00:12:00,250 --> 00:12:03,979
eu posso simplesmente simular de novo dentro dela.

187
00:12:03,979 --> 00:12:06,260
Assim, não será tão fácil ter conflitos,

188
00:12:06,260 --> 00:12:07,780
nem tão fácil de penetrar.

189
00:12:07,780 --> 00:12:09,520
E evita que várias instabilidades aconteçam.

190
00:12:09,520 --> 00:12:13,180
E também o nó não se solta.

191
00:12:19,020 --> 00:12:20,580
Aumente o atrito.

192
00:12:20,580 --> 00:12:24,220
Aumentar o atrito permite que o tecido

193
00:12:24,220 --> 00:12:28,170
Ou seja, quando você aperta o nó, ele fica mais lento.

194
00:12:28,170 --> 00:12:32,570
E isso vai reduzir a possibilidade de ele se desfazer ou de atravessar o tecido.

195
00:12:38,920 --> 00:12:41,080
Agora pegamos o que copiamos por dentro.

196
00:12:41,080 --> 00:12:45,320
Também costurei uma camada na parte de trás do cavalinho.

197
00:12:53,260 --> 00:12:56,140
Depois, vou continuar ajustando para que fique mais natural.

198
00:12:56,140 --> 00:12:58,260
Porque sinto que o nó está um pouco grande demais.

199
00:12:58,260 --> 00:13:00,500
Então eu dei uma taxa de encolhimento de trama nele,

200
00:13:00,500 --> 00:13:02,480
para que este nó ficasse um pouco menor.

201
00:13:02,650 --> 00:13:06,290
E então continue a congelar a parte do nó.

202
00:13:06,290 --> 00:13:11,130
Aí simulamos esta parte da cauda do nosso cavalinho.

203
00:13:11,550 --> 00:13:14,990
E vamos ajustar a proporção de elasticidade das duas pontas curtas

204
00:13:14,990 --> 00:13:17,390
para deixá-las um pouco menores.

205
00:13:19,400 --> 00:13:22,200
Assim, ele parecerá mais apertado.

206
00:13:22,200 --> 00:13:24,160
Mais natural.

207
00:13:35,680 --> 00:13:39,340
Em seguida, vamos descongelar todos os painéis para uma simulação rápida.

208
00:13:39,340 --> 00:13:42,280
para que a relação entre os tecidos

209
00:13:42,280 --> 00:13:44,480
seja simulada de forma mais precisa.

210
00:13:44,769 --> 00:13:46,249
Após confirmar o modelo,

211
00:13:46,249 --> 00:13:51,369
Podemos começar a criar este pequeno pônei.

212
00:13:52,009 --> 00:13:56,489
Escolhi uma cor para o pônei do ícone da MD.

213
00:13:56,489 --> 00:13:59,409
Desejo a todos um Ano Novo cheio de sucesso!

214
00:13:59,650 --> 00:14:02,850
Depois, mudei o material para plástico.

215
00:14:05,320 --> 00:14:08,560
E aumentei a intensidade da superfície.

216
00:14:09,960 --> 00:14:12,560
Diminuí a rugosidade.

217
00:14:14,120 --> 00:14:18,080
Depois, carreguei uma textura em forma de moeda antiga.

218
00:14:18,080 --> 00:14:20,600
Para usar como os olhos do pônei.

219
00:14:24,680 --> 00:14:28,320
E quando usamos esse tipo de textura,

220
00:14:28,320 --> 00:14:30,400
Pode ligá-lo na costura.

221
00:14:30,400 --> 00:14:34,180
Este padrão pode ser usado em duas placas.

222
00:14:43,220 --> 00:14:47,900
E para que todas as costuras na superfície do pequeno cavalo

223
00:14:47,900 --> 00:14:49,420
Não afeta tanto.

224
00:14:49,420 --> 00:14:54,470
Então, eu juntei todas essas linhas de costura.

225
00:14:55,280 --> 00:15:00,160
Assim, parece mais um balão sem costuras.

226
00:15:12,480 --> 00:15:16,680
Vamos fundir todas as costuras do lado virado para nós.

227
00:15:27,180 --> 00:15:28,880
E as costas?

228
00:15:28,880 --> 00:15:31,340
Porque agora temos apenas uma peça.

229
00:15:31,340 --> 00:15:32,700
Já dei uma volta completa.

230
00:15:32,700 --> 00:15:35,440
Mas ainda podemos fazer com que

231
00:15:35,760 --> 00:15:38,680
ainda podemos fazer com que fique um pouco mais discreto.

232
00:15:38,680 --> 00:15:43,090
Acabei de remover o mapa normal da costura.

233
00:15:43,090 --> 00:15:45,490
Não o mapa normal dos pontos de costura.

234
00:15:45,490 --> 00:15:47,760
Aí ficará ainda menos visível.

235
00:15:47,760 --> 00:15:51,040
Aí, na mesma peça...

236
00:15:51,040 --> 00:15:54,430
Atualmente, no nosso software, se estivermos na mesma peça...

237
00:15:54,430 --> 00:15:59,440
A textura dela, mesmo que ativada na costura, vai aparecer...

238
00:15:59,440 --> 00:16:02,320
Também não é possível usar diretamente em painéis diferentes.

239
00:16:02,320 --> 00:16:04,260
Então, vocês podem copiar e colar de novo.

240
00:16:04,260 --> 00:16:06,250
E montar vocês mesmos.

241
00:16:06,250 --> 00:16:10,450
Então, aqui eu apliquei uma malha quadriculada,

242
00:16:10,450 --> 00:16:13,110
isso vai deixar a superfície do nosso modelo

243
00:16:13,110 --> 00:16:16,170
mais suave.

244
00:16:18,280 --> 00:16:19,360
Assim, nossa Pônei Balão está pronta!

245
00:16:19,360 --> 00:16:23,040
Terminamos de fazer a nossa Pônei Balão!

1
00:00:00,280 --> 00:00:00,720
Hello

2
00:00:00,720 --> 00:00:01,320
Hello everyone

3
00:00:01,320 --> 00:00:05,830
I am HAZ, a designer from Mario Designer.

4
00:00:05,830 --> 00:00:08,430
Tonight, as we approach the Spring Festival,

5
00:00:08,430 --> 00:00:12,059
We will bring you two uh

6
00:00:12,059 --> 00:00:14,159
in Marvelous Designer

7
00:00:14,159 --> 00:00:17,239
Tutorial on how to create two styles of small horse designs

8
00:00:17,239 --> 00:00:20,869
And next to us is our old friend Shirley.

9
00:00:20,869 --> 00:00:22,169
Ms. Xuemei

10
00:00:23,809 --> 00:00:27,060
Teacher Xuelin will be in my Live Studio

11
00:00:27,060 --> 00:00:30,500
act as little D in the danmu (bullet comment) to answer questions for everyone

12
00:00:30,500 --> 00:00:33,140
Then during our Live

13
00:00:33,140 --> 00:00:36,360
There will also be lucky draws at the end of the event.

14
00:00:36,360 --> 00:00:42,290
At the same time, we can also get our officially produced items for free.

15
00:00:42,290 --> 00:00:43,790
WeChat red envelope cover

16
00:00:43,790 --> 00:00:49,070
Then I will explain in the first half

17
00:00:49,070 --> 00:00:50,790
how to make these two ponies

18
00:00:50,790 --> 00:00:53,240
Teacher Sherry will cover it in the final part

19
00:00:53,240 --> 00:00:56,740
explain how to create our WeChat red packet cover

20
00:00:56,740 --> 00:00:58,660
the final carousel

21
00:00:58,660 --> 00:01:01,910
a very nice rendering

22
00:01:01,910 --> 00:01:04,930
Alright, let's get started.

23
00:01:16,860 --> 00:01:20,380
First up is our balloon pony

24
00:01:20,700 --> 00:01:24,340
Our balloon pony is composed of multiple balloon segments.

25
00:01:24,340 --> 00:01:27,940
So first, let's create a rectangular panel

26
00:01:27,940 --> 00:01:30,720
Then use the clone layer to duplicate it

27
00:01:30,720 --> 00:01:33,500
then flip its surface

28
00:01:37,160 --> 00:01:41,240
Then reduce its particle spacing and collision thickness

29
00:01:43,560 --> 00:01:45,680
then add a bit more pressure to it

30
00:01:45,680 --> 00:01:47,160
Now enable the simulation

31
00:01:47,160 --> 00:01:50,479
it will turn into a plump little pillow shape

32
00:01:50,479 --> 00:01:54,759
Then we'll delete the sewing lines on both short sides.

33
00:01:54,759 --> 00:01:58,450
change the sewing method of the long edge to

34
00:01:58,450 --> 00:01:59,970
change it to overlap seam

35
00:01:59,970 --> 00:02:02,410
it will form a tubular shape

36
00:02:03,490 --> 00:02:06,840
Then add elasticity to the two short edges

37
00:02:06,840 --> 00:02:09,240
set it to a ratio of 25

38
00:02:09,240 --> 00:02:10,680
it will shrink up

39
00:02:10,680 --> 00:02:13,470
like the shape of a sausage

40
00:02:13,630 --> 00:02:17,430
Then we reduce its warp and weft strength as well as diagonal tension

41
00:02:17,430 --> 00:02:19,310
to make it more elastic

42
00:02:19,310 --> 00:02:22,019
and increase its bending strength

43
00:02:22,019 --> 00:02:22,759
Uh, no

44
00:02:22,759 --> 00:02:24,339
reduce its bending stiffness

45
00:02:24,339 --> 00:02:27,899
so that it can produce more fine wrinkles

46
00:02:29,000 --> 00:02:33,800
This will make it look more like the shape of balloon skin

47
00:02:34,280 --> 00:02:35,480
After modifying the properties

48
00:02:35,480 --> 00:02:36,280
Let's simulate it

49
00:02:36,280 --> 00:02:37,140
take a look

50
00:02:37,140 --> 00:02:39,080
The elasticity still feels insufficient

51
00:02:39,080 --> 00:02:41,110
so I lowered it a bit more

52
00:02:41,110 --> 00:02:44,270
Mmm, adjust the warp and weft strength

53
00:02:46,400 --> 00:02:49,820
Then I adjusted its weight to make it a bit lighter.

54
00:02:49,820 --> 00:02:51,760
Because balloons are very light

55
00:02:51,760 --> 00:02:53,360
It ends up looking like this

56
00:02:53,360 --> 00:02:55,890
somewhat like the shape of a gummy candy

57
00:02:55,890 --> 00:03:00,850
Then we can start using this basic balloon segment

58
00:03:00,850 --> 00:03:04,930
to replicate the various structures of the pony's body

59
00:03:11,200 --> 00:03:14,000
First, duplicate two pairs of the pony's legs

60
00:03:15,200 --> 00:03:17,560
then comes the pony's body

61
00:03:19,520 --> 00:03:23,960
Next is the tail of the pony and the part of its neck

62
00:03:30,420 --> 00:03:31,140
Hello there

63
00:03:31,140 --> 00:03:32,620
QQ Field

64
00:03:34,020 --> 00:03:38,540
Then there's his head and two ears

65
00:03:40,940 --> 00:03:45,980
Then arrange the special mane on its back as well

66
00:03:46,870 --> 00:03:49,490
We copied three small balloon segments

67
00:03:49,490 --> 00:03:51,390
as its mane

68
00:03:54,640 --> 00:03:59,460
Then adjust the lengths of these balloon segments slightly

69
00:03:59,460 --> 00:04:03,000
to resemble the various parts of the pony

70
00:04:05,400 --> 00:04:07,320
quick adjustment

71
00:04:09,080 --> 00:04:10,480
After roughly placing them

72
00:04:10,480 --> 00:04:12,180
we can now start sewing

73
00:04:12,180 --> 00:04:14,060
Because its legs, uh,

74
00:04:14,060 --> 00:04:15,380
in real life

75
00:04:15,380 --> 00:04:17,540
It is a very long balloon

76
00:04:17,540 --> 00:04:20,089
to continuously twist and tie

77
00:04:20,089 --> 00:04:23,190
to create these body structures

78
00:04:23,190 --> 00:04:28,320
So the upper and lower parts of our legs are all sewing groups

79
00:04:31,680 --> 00:04:36,280
sew each balloon segment to its designated position

80
00:04:49,660 --> 00:04:53,880
Sew the pony's head, body, and ears together

81
00:04:53,880 --> 00:04:55,340
Sometimes when sewing too fast

82
00:04:55,340 --> 00:04:57,810
Sewing line errors may occur

83
00:04:57,810 --> 00:05:00,990
just right-click the sewing button if it's reversed

84
00:05:00,990 --> 00:05:04,390
then just swap it over

85
00:05:08,360 --> 00:05:11,120
After checking that all these sewing lines are properly stitched

86
00:05:11,120 --> 00:05:12,600
we can then start the simulation

87
00:05:12,600 --> 00:05:15,409
Combine Xiao Man's body parts together

88
00:05:15,649 --> 00:05:19,769
Then we'll separately assemble these three brown mane balloon segments

89
00:05:19,769 --> 00:05:21,849
combine them together

90
00:05:23,520 --> 00:05:27,600
Then we stand up our little horse lying on the ground

91
00:05:30,020 --> 00:05:33,900
rotate its legs to the correct orientation

92
00:05:36,080 --> 00:05:41,490
and also rotate its ears to the side

93
00:05:41,490 --> 00:05:45,310
Then we can begin to locally freeze some panels

94
00:05:45,310 --> 00:05:50,220
to perform more delicate simulation of this pony's body

95
00:05:50,220 --> 00:05:51,280
and adjustments

96
00:05:51,280 --> 00:05:54,580
Since I feel the legs of this little horse are a bit short here

97
00:05:54,580 --> 00:05:58,550
so I froze the other parts of its body

98
00:05:58,550 --> 00:06:01,410
then lengthened the legs of this little horse

99
00:06:01,410 --> 00:06:04,840
Then simulate it again, hmm

100
00:06:04,840 --> 00:06:10,739
Hmm, then added a bunch of, uh, inner lines on the pony's face

101
00:06:10,739 --> 00:06:13,019
Added an additional inner line

102
00:06:13,019 --> 00:06:14,919
then gave it elasticity

103
00:06:14,919 --> 00:06:16,459
It's like a rubber band

104
00:06:16,459 --> 00:06:18,579
like a band tightening around the pony's nose

105
00:06:18,579 --> 00:06:22,230
giving it the feeling of a pony's face

106
00:06:22,350 --> 00:06:25,850
Then sew its ears on as well

107
00:06:25,850 --> 00:06:28,050
This part was forgotten to be sewn earlier

108
00:06:28,050 --> 00:06:30,430
Its ears should be the same as its legs

109
00:06:30,430 --> 00:06:31,750
both the top and bottom are sewn together

110
00:06:31,750 --> 00:06:34,150
this this structure

111
00:06:35,680 --> 00:06:39,800
How could it be

112
00:06:49,160 --> 00:06:52,340
Then here, I added two connecting parts to its mane section

113
00:06:52,340 --> 00:06:55,160
added two connecting parts

114
00:06:55,160 --> 00:06:57,980
Because if we directly attach this mane part

115
00:06:57,980 --> 00:07:00,300
connected to the pony's body

116
00:07:00,300 --> 00:07:04,570
between the ear and the neck

117
00:07:04,570 --> 00:07:08,090
and the gap between the body and the neck is too deep

118
00:07:08,090 --> 00:07:12,159
will cause deformation in the mane area

119
00:07:12,159 --> 00:07:16,139
so we need two small connecting pieces without pressure
